description: Margin builder (rewrite of I041 onto the current tip). Muon lr 0.24 / momentum 0.6 come from airbench94_muon's CIFAR-10 37-to-10-epoch setting at batch 2000. D007 (C0053/C0056/C0065) says shorter horizons favor different step sizes, and Muon tolerates larger lr. On tip E028 (9.5 ep, batch 2048), change only the Muon peak lr, from 0.24 to 0.32: same schedule shape, same momentum, SGD groups unchanged. The precomputed GPU LR table changes; nothing else does.
